match.title: India vs West Indies
match.h2h: India and the West Indies share one of cricket's most storied rivalries, evolving from total West Indian dominance in the 20th century to modern-day mastery by India. The comprehensive head-to-head records across all three major formats of international cricket show how the teams match up: 📊 Overall Head-to-Head Record Format Total Matches India Won West Indies Won Tied No Result / Draw Test Matches 102 25 30 0 47 One Day Internationals (ODIs) 144 64 74 2 4 T20 Internationals (T20Is) 31 20 10 0 1
